approval: Owner explicitly requested silent automatic first installation of the Warder IPTV radio bouquet into the receiver radio list. Prior authorization for repository writes and production updates remains in force.

release.changelog: Tichá automatická inštalácia nášho IPTV rádio bouquetu a zaradenie medzi rádiá. Bez duplicitných položiek a bez zmeny osobných zoznamov. Overený obsah, sťahovanie na pozadí, opakovanie pri výpadku internetu a zachované týždenné aktualizácie.

validation.receiver_validation: Automated first-install, offline retry, checksum, index preservation, duplicate, concurrent-edit and lifecycle tests. Existing virtual keyboard was owner-confirmed on the receiver; this new radio import has not yet been tested on a physical receiver.
